say:1:1710337001:1.text: This is Mithril Consortium Staff No. 1095. How may I assist you?
say:1:1710337001:1.source_cn: 秘银工号1095，很高兴为您服务，您有什么需要的吗？

say:2:1710337002:1.text: I... I want to lodge a complaint about your product. The actual item doesn't match what's shown on the packaging.
say:2:1710337002:1.source_cn: 我……我要投诉。我要投诉你们的商品包装与实际产品不符。

say:3:1710337003:1.text: Could you specify which product it is? Do you have it with you so we can inspect it?
say:3:1710337003:1.source_cn: 请问是哪款产品出现了您所说的问题呢？有实物可以看下吗？

say:4:1710337004:1.text: Look at this toy. The packaging clearly shows a fox, but inside it's a drake!
say:4:1710337004:1.source_cn: 我们买的这款玩偶，包装上明明是只狐狸，为什么打开以后变...

say:5:1710337005:1.text: Ah, you must have overlooked the fine print. It says, "Image for reference only; actual product may vary."
say:5:1710337005:1.source_cn: 哦哦，您请看，包装上有行小字写着，“图片仅供参考，产品...

say:6:1710337006:1.text: Madam, you're incredibly lucky to have gotten the secret toy! There's only one in a hundred boxes, and it's worth ten times more than the fox toy!
say:6:1710337006:1.source_cn: 这位女士您很幸运啊！抽中了出现概率为百分之一的隐藏款！...

say:9:1710337008:1.text: Then let's get another box, Mommy! I really want the fox toy!
say:9:1710337008:1.source_cn: 既然这样，妈妈，我们再买一个吧！我还想再要一个狐狸的！
